attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "This reverts a concurrency fix, reintroducing a semaphore-based lock (held for the duration of shape table building, including scoped service resolution across DI scopes) and caching ShapeTable directly instead of Task<ShapeTable>, which can reintroduce race conditions or deadlocks under concurrent multi-tenant first-request shape table builds."}

reason: This reverts a concurrency fix, reintroducing a semaphore-based lock (held for the duration of shape table building, including scoped service resolution across DI scopes) and caching ShapeTable directly instead of Task<ShapeTable>, which can reintroduce race conditions or deadlocks under concurrent multi-tenant first-request shape table builds.
